access.roleRequiredBody: Your current account role does not include permission to view this section. Role changes are strictly controlled by platform administrators in Firestore security rules.

session.warningRemainingBody: Remaining warnings before permanent ban: {remaining}. At 3 warnings, this account is automatically banned.
session.bannedBody: This Dhruv Tales account has been banned and disabled across all devices and APIs. You can no longer sign in or stream episodes until an administrator reviews and restores your account.
session.supportHeading: Need help or believe this is a mistake?

home.catalogSourceLocal: Built-in Seed Catalog (Sign in as Admin on Profile to seed Firestore)
home.transparencySubtitle: Dhruv Tales runs with zero AI APIs. Discovery uses plain database queries, and all audio/video playback resolves through an interchangeable MediaProvider adapter.

search.title: Discover Stories
search.subtitle: Filter by genre, language, creator, or search by title.
search.emptyBody: Try clearing one of your filters or searching with a different keyword.

story.storyPriceOverrideBanner: Admin story-level price active: {price} Coins per episode
story.signInToUnlock: Sign in to claim your daily free unlock and sync it to your Firebase account.

story.notFoundBody: The story you requested does not exist in the catalog.

interactive.noPressureNote: Playback paused — take your time. No countdown, no pressure.
interactive.constellationSubtitle: Every decision illuminates a new path across the constellation. Select any visited node to inspect your choice or replay from that crossroads.

library.title: Your Library
library.subtitle: Your listening history, saved stories, followed creators, and daily unlocks.
library.emptyHistory: You haven't listened to any episodes yet.
library.emptyBookmarks: No bookmarked stories yet. Save stories to listen later.
library.emptyFollowing: You aren't following any creators yet.
library.guestSyncBanner: Browsing as Guest — progress, choices, and bookmarks are saved locally on this device. Sign in to sync with Cloud Firestore.

profile.title: Account & Settings
profile.signInSub: Sync your listening progress, interactive choices, preferred media format, bookmarks, and daily unlocks across devices via Firebase.
profile.otpSentNotice: Verification code sent to {phone}. Enter the 6-digit code below.
profile.phoneAuthConsoleNote: Phone Auth code path is wired with Firebase Phone Auth. Before real SMS sign-in works, enable Phone under Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method (Blaze billing applies for SMS beyond free daily test quotas). Single-device enforcement applies per user account across Google, Email, and Phone login.
profile.emailAuthConsoleNote: Note: Google Sign-In is pre-configured. Email/Password auth requires enabling the Email/Password provider in Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method.
profile.verifyEmailBanner: Please verify your email address to enable cloud sync with Firestore. Check your inbox for the verification link.
profile.becomeCreatorDesc: Apply to publish audio & video series and interactive branching tales in Creator Studio. An administrator reviews every application.
profile.walletDesc: Buy demo coin packages, inspect your immutable coin ledger, and view permanently unlocked episodes.
profile.seedSubtitle: Populate Cloud Firestore with 12 original stories (including 2 interactive branching series), 70 episodes, 8 genres, 6 creators, default coin packages, and economy settings.
profile.seedAdminOnly: Sign in with an Admin account to seed Cloud Firestore directly.
profile.dangerDesc: Permanently remove your profile, listening history, interactive choices, bookmarks, daily unlocks, and Firebase Authentication account.
profile.confirmDeleteBody: This action cannot be undone. All your Firestore profile data, interactive story paths, bookmarks, and playback progress will be deleted.

wallet.title: Coin Wallet
wallet.subtitle: Top up coins using demo packages and unlock paid episodes permanently on your account.
wallet.demoNoticeTitle: Demo payments only — No real money charged
wallet.demoNoticeServer: Coin purchases run through MockPaymentProvider and record atomically in your server-authoritative Firestore wallet and immutable coinTransactions ledger. A real gateway (Razorpay) plugs in later.
wallet.demoNoticeLocal: Local preview mode: Coin top-ups and unlocks use a browser-local demo ledger (no client Firestore writes). When connected to the backend API with Firebase Admin configured, all wallet mutations run atomically via /api/coins/*.
wallet.serverAuthNote: Read-only client wallet — all balance updates happen server-side via immutable ledger entries.
wallet.dailyFreeInfo: Daily Free Episode is enabled by Admin — daily free allowance: {limit} per day.
wallet.buyCoinsSubtitle: Admin-defined coin packs with instant demo credit.
wallet.noPackages: No active coin packages are available right now.
wallet.emptyHistory: No coin transactions yet. Buy a demo coin package or unlock a paid episode to populate your immutable ledger.
wallet.checkoutDisclaimer: Processed via MockPaymentProvider for testing only — zero real money, card, or UPI charge. Razorpay plugs into the same PaymentProvider later.
wallet.purchaseError: Could not complete demo coin purchase.
wallet.myCoinsInsightsSubtitle: Track which stories you support most and how your coin credits and unlocks change over time.
wallet.noSpendByStoryYet: Unlock any paid episode to see your story-by-story coin breakdown.
wallet.noActivityChartYet: No coin activity in this timeframe yet.

analytics.perUserSubtitle: Search any user to inspect wallet balance, spend history by story & episode, listening activity, warnings, device/session logs, and ban state.

unlockModal.storyOverrideNote: Admin story-level price override is active for this series.
unlockModal.insufficientCoins: You need {shortfall} more coins to unlock this episode.
unlockModal.permanentNote: Once unlocked with coins, this episode stays unlocked permanently on your account — replay anytime without paying again.
unlockModal.dailyFreeCta: Use Daily Free Unlock ({remaining}/{limit} left today)
unlockModal.errorGeneric: Could not unlock this episode right now.

studio.title: Creator Studio
studio.subtitle: Publish original audio & video stories, upload local media via MediaProvider, wire interactive branches, and monitor listener analytics.
studio.deleteStoryConfirm: Delete this story and all of its episodes?
studio.noStoriesTitle: No stories in your studio yet
studio.noStoriesBody: Create your first serialized audio or video story to begin publishing episodes.
studio.selectStoryPrompt: Select a story to manage episodes
studio.priceSetOnceHint: Set once on upload. After creation, only an Admin can change an episode's price.
studio.priceLockedHint: Locked after upload — only an Admin can update this episode's price.
studio.videoSlotLabel: Video Media Slot (Optional — enables Audio ⇄ Video)
studio.videoPortraitInstruction: Upload a 9:16 portrait video (1080 × 1920 / 720 × 1280) or a 16:9 landscape video (1920 × 1080 / 1280 × 720). Playback matches your uploaded format automatically.
studio.videoAspectRatioError: This video is {width} × {height}. Dhruv Tales supports vertical 9:16 (1080 × 1920 / 720 × 1280) and horizontal 16:9 (1920 × 1080 / 1280 × 720) videos.
studio.videoMetadataUnreadableError: We could not read the dimensions of this video file. Please retry or choose another 9:16 or 16:9 video file.
studio.driveImportTitle: Import Episodes from Google Drive Folder
studio.driveNamingBody: Share your Drive folder (Viewer) with the Dhruv Tales service account. Audio and video files with the same episode number merge into one draft episode.
studio.driveLimitsNotice: Testing & low-traffic storage only (not production DRM). Streaming runs via short-lived signed URLs.
studio.driveFolderLabel: Google Drive Folder ID or Shared Folder URL
studio.driveFolderRequired: Please paste a Google Drive folder ID or folder link.
studio.driveImportGenericError: Unable to import episodes from this Drive folder.
studio.enableChoiceToggle: Attach an interactive choice point to this episode
studio.analyticsSub: Plays and completion rates derived directly from Firestore listeningHistory records for your stories.
studio.noAnalyticsYet: No tracked listeningHistory plays yet for this story. Play an episode to generate live completion metrics.
studio.ownershipNotice: Security rules ensure creators can only edit or delete stories and episodes where they are the registered owner.

admin.title: Admin Dashboard
admin.subtitle: Platform moderation, user role governance, creator approvals, category management, and immutable audit logging.
admin.trashEmpty: Trash is empty. Soft-deleted stories and episodes will appear here for safe restore or permanent deletion.
admin.searchUsersPlaceholder: Search users by name, email, phone, or UID...
admin.banModalDesc: Banning disables the Firebase Auth account, revokes active tokens, clears activeDevice, blocks all /api routes, and records an audit log.
admin.banReasonPlaceholder: e.g., Repeated account sharing across devices
admin.unbanModalDesc: Restores Firebase Auth access, clears banned status, and sets warningCount to your chosen value (0–2).
admin.sessionApiUnavailable: Server-side /api/session/admin is not reachable or missing Firebase Admin credentials. Run the backend API server with Firebase Admin env vars (and set VITE_API_BASE_URL if using static hosting) to execute ban, unban, token revocation, and force-logout actions.
admin.searchStoriesPlaceholder: Search stories by title, creator, or visibility...
admin.storyOverrideActive: Active override: every episode in this story costs {price} coins.
admin.storyOverrideNone: No override — using each episode's own coin price.
admin.dailyFreeDesc: Toggle daily free unlocks on/off and set how many paid episodes a listener can unlock free each day.
admin.coinPackagesDesc: Create, edit, activate/deactivate, or delete coin packages shown on the Wallet page.
admin.walletAdjustDesc: Issue bonuses, refunds, or manual coin adjustments through server-side /api/coins/admin-adjust (writes an immutable coinTransactions entry and audit log).
admin.adjustAmountInvalid: Enter a non-zero integer coin amount.
admin.adjustNoteRequired: Please enter an audit note explaining this adjustment.
admin.auditNotice: Every admin action writes an immutable, append-only entry to Firestore auditLogs (updates and deletes are blocked in security rules).
admin.noAuditLogs: No audit log entries recorded yet.
